[1;36mtfli -- x.log -- 3 RPC spans, 3 UI spans[0m

KEYS

VIEWS
  1          providers
  2          types
  4          calls
  5          timeline
  6          raw log

THE LIST
  ↑ ↓ j k    move the cursor in the focused pane
  ← → h l    step within a timeline lane -- the footer's ↔
  PgUp PgDn  page through the raw log
  ⏎ Enter    open the selected call in the raw log
  s          sort by the next column, in the table views

FILTERING
  ␣ Space    toggle the facet value under the cursor
  f          show the facets and give them the keyboard
  Esc        clear every active filter -- or close this help
  /          search the raw log for a pattern
  n N        step to the next or previous match

EVERYWHERE
  ⇥ Tab      move focus between panes
  ?          open or close this help (Esc closes it too)
  q          quit

? close
q quit
